visible_text: 決まったことが出たら、ここに並びます
やることが出たら、ここに並びます
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Mostly one surface, but the small black pill toolbar at the very top (record/pause/comment/expand/more/stop icons) floats above and overlaps the edge of the main white card like a separate mini window docked on top of it. The main card itself (left transcript/notes column plus right panel with tabs) reads as one continuous piece.
answers.q2: Only loosely. The header says '23:33 の会議' which is just a timestamp used as a placeholder title, not an actual meeting name, participant list, or calling app/source. There's a footer link 'AI が見ている資料' (material AI is looking at) but it isn't expanded or specified, so I can't tell which document or call source is actually feeding it.
answers.q3: It is actively recording audio (録音中, timer at 00:02, pulsing dot pattern) and listening for speech ('聞いています…'), but no speech has been transcribed yet ('まだ発話がありません'). It's waiting for someone to actually talk so it can fill in the transcript, decisions, and action items, which are all still empty placeholders.
answers.q4: The recording status and elapsed timer (録音中 00:02) in the top-left, since that's the one piece of information confirming the app is live and capturing right now.
answers.q5: The top floating pill toolbar is a bit unclear in how it relates to the card beneath it (it looks bolted on rather than part of the same surface), and its icon-only buttons (pause, speech bubble, expand, more, stop) have no labels so their function isn't obvious at a glance. The generic '23:33 の会議' title also adds little real information.

weaknesses.what: The black pill control bar at the top overlaps the main card's edge and reads as a separate floating overlay rather than part of the same surface.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the controls into the main card's header bar (or give them a connecting visual seam) so it reads as one piece, not a widget stacked on top.

weaknesses.what: The meeting title is just an auto-generated timestamp ('23:33 の会議') with no participant names, source app, or calendar link visible.
weaknesses.fix: Surface the actual meeting title/participants or the app/call source being captured so the user can confirm what is being recorded.
